law_R2v4_pace_aware_ema.statement: The EMA effective window N_ema = 1/(1-tau) must grow with the optimizer's per-latent pace p = lr/LAT. Registered calibration: 1 - tau = K4 * LAT / lr with K4 = 1.5e-6; at the registered operating point (lr = 0.3, LAT = 4) this yields 1 - tau = 2e-5, tau = 0.99998 (N_ema = 50,000).
law_R2v4_pace_aware_ema.justification_from_receipts: Direction fixed by the cross-round receipts: round-2 (starved pace p = 0.02/1024 = 1.95e-5, tau = 0.999) drift/norm 1.08e-4 PASS; round-3 (working pace p = 0.3/4 = 0.075, SAME tau = 0.999) drift/norm 1.061e-1 FAIL — a 3840x pace increase broke a gate that a 1x window survived; therefore the window, not tau alone, is the invariant to register. Magnitude fixed by the pre-seal drift curve (receipts/design4.json partA, pace 0.075): (1-tau, drift/norm) = (1e-3, 1.061e-1), (7e-4, 7.926e-2), (5e-4, 5.919e-2), (1e-4, 1.296e-2 FAIL), (2e-5, 2.640e-3 PASS). The 0.01 gate (round-2 threshold, UNCHANGED) requires 1-tau < ~7.5e-5 at this pace; 2e-5 gives 3.8x margin. K4 = 1.5e-6 is the calibrated constant making 1-tau = 2e-5 at p = 0.075.
law_R2v4_pace_aware_ema.mechanism_receipted: design4 partA also shows WHY the law works: Wc's own 200-step displacement is ~0.16 of norm at EVERY tau (oscillatory churn, not persistent trend), and the EMA averages that churn out — at tau = 0.99998 Wt is ~61x more stationary than Wc itself over the same window. Round 2 passed this gate the same way (target quasi-static RELATIVE to a starved optimizer); round 4 keeps the property by making the WINDOW scale with pace instead of starving the optimizer.
law_R2v4_pace_aware_ema.honest_cost_declared_up_front: At p = 0.075 the calibrated window (5e4) exceeds the training horizon (400 steps), so target-encoder plasticity over the horizon is expected SMALL: design4 measured Wt total movement 4.258e-3 of norm over the full 400 steps (vs 1.781e-1 at tau = 0.999). This is receipted per-run and gates nothing — declared now, not discovered later. The no-collapse guard (target-latent variance >= 0.5x init) and the learning guards (G, R1 still pass at the registered tau) are part of the claim so the law cannot buy stationarity by breaking the model.
law_R2v4_pace_aware_ema.transfer_caveat_registered: K4 is calibrated at the single operating pace p = 0.075 from five measured curve points; the cross-round pace pairs (1.95e-5 vs 0.075) fix the law's DIRECTION but not a universal constant (churn is not linear in pace: S/pace differs ~4x between the two points). Any future round that changes lr MUST re-probe the drift curve before re-registering K (design-probe law).

law_R3v4_percentile_normalized_surprise.statement: Per-cell surprise s_c(t) = |zPred_c - zTgt_c|^2 is first normalized against the cell's OWN empirical distribution over the 124 baseline ticks of the eval window (401-530 excluding the 3 anomaly ticks and their +1 recovery ticks): z_c(t) = (s_c(t) - mu_c) / sd_c, with mu_c, sd_c that cell's baseline mean and (population) std, z := 0 where sd_c = 0. Concentration = mean of the top-4 cells BY z (intruder footprint 2x2 = 4 cells; selection and value both on z). Verdict statistic: mean z-concentration over the 3 registered anomaly ticks (430, 465, 500) exceeds 3x the mean over the 30 registered baseline ticks (first 30 of the 124, the round-3 sample law). Gate > 3.0 UNCHANGED from rounds 2-3.
law_R3v4_percentile_normalized_surprise.why_zscore_and_not_literal_rank: The round-4 brief's literal candidates (rank-transform / ECDF map) were probed and REJECTED on receipt: a pure rank transform compresses the top of every cell's distribution to u ~ 1.0, and the top-4-of-256 selection is an extreme-value operation — design4 measured the rank concentration ratio at 1.010 (self-select) and 1.037 (raw-select) at the registered tau: statistically indistinguishable from no signal, because the ball's own passage saturates its cells' history ranks exactly as the intruder does. The per-cell z-score is the same law (judge each cell against its own distribution, not the global cross-cell scale) while preserving magnitude: an intruder cell at 25x its own baseline sigma scores 25, a ball cell at 2x scores 2. Per-cell z over the cell's own 124-tick baseline IS the ECDF's affine summary (location + spread); the full-ECDF and MAD variants are receipted as contrasts and gate nothing.
law_R3v4_percentile_normalized_surprise.normalizer_details_registered: mu_c/sd_c computed over ALL 124 baseline ticks (population std); the concentration BASELINE remains the registered 30-tick sample set (first 30 of the 124 — identical tick list to round 3) so the ratio is comparable to v3's; anomaly application timing unchanged (intruder +0.9 on the 2x2 block at (bx+8, by+8) applied to obsNew BEFORE scoring); the world's own occluder events (ticks 480/481 fall in-window) stay in the 124-tick per-cell baselines by design — they are part of each cell's own empirical distribution.
law_R3v4_percentile_normalized_surprise.contrasts_receipted_gate_nothing: raw (v3 law, expect ~1.85), per-cell MAD-robust z, per-cell ECDF rank (self-select and raw-select), own-history-max cell counts, excess-rank difference, global-mean ratio (v3's contrast law).
